title: Trombonist Eddie Vincent, who shares his name
summary: Asked about Eddie Vinson, Vincent says he met him in Chicago, noted that they share a name, and could not place him otherwise.

blocks.x: I asked him, did he know Eddie Vinson?

So did you know Eddie Vinson? Who? Eddie Vinson. Eddie? Eddie Vinson. Eddie Vinson. Eddie Vinson. He's a trombone. Same name with me. Yeah, a trombone player. So did you know him? No, I don't know him. You didn't know Eddie Vinson? No. I know him. Eddie Vinson. The same name with my last name, B-I-N-C-E-N-T. Yeah. I don't know where he lived yet. He's from here, but he left. From Algiers. I can't remember him. From Crossroads. He said he's from open Algiers. I can't remember him. I met him in Chicago. Yeah.
